plants.original: Prime Minister Bart De Wever went to the Royal Palace on Monday and was widely expected to offer his resignation, Belgian media reported, after late-night talks in his five-party coalition again failed to agree on next year's budget. The government has argued for months over €10bn ($11.2bn) in cuts and tax increases. De Tijd cited sources saying King Philippe was not expected to accept at once and could send him back for a last round of talks.
